style: エルと館長の容貌・衣装は美術設定。消防係は人数未確定の呼称表示。選んだ本や火・受領状態を共通人物画へ固定しない。

files.prompt_en: Use case: illustration-story. Full-body character sprite for a Japanese fantasy adventure game, 1024 by 1536 portrait canvas with a transparent background. A single scribe named El, with copper-brown hair gathered in a long loose braid, attentive eyes and a composed, quietly concerned expression. El wears a warm grey linen work tunic, a sleeveless indigo vest, a narrow brown belt, charcoal trousers and practical lace-up leather boots. The cuffs show faint ink stains. Standing upright in a relaxed balanced stance, facing the viewer with a slight three-quarter turn. Both bare hands are empty and visible, gently resting near the waist and side. Detailed painted fabric, leather and hair with gentle natural lighting. Entire head and both feet remain inside the frame, with modest transparent padding. One isolated figure with clean alpha edges and even illumination suited to compositing over light and dark game backgrounds. A reusable conversation portrait with a clear silhouette. The surrounding canvas is empty and transparent.
files.prompt_ja: 日本語ファンタジーアドベンチャー用の全身人物スプライト。1024×1536の縦長キャンバス、背景は透過。写本師エル一人。赤銅色の髪を長い緩い三つ編みにまとめ、注意深い目と静かな心配を含む落ち着いた表情。暖かな灰色の麻の作業チュニック、袖のない藍色のベスト、細い茶色のベルト、炭色のズボン、実用的な編み上げの革靴。袖口には薄いインクの跡。安定した自然な立ち姿で、ほぼ正面から少しだけ斜めを向く。空の両手を見せ、腰と体の脇に軽く添える。布・革・髪を丁寧に描き、穏やかな自然光を当てる。頭頂と両足を画面内へ収め、周囲に控えめな透過余白を取る。一人だけを切り出し、輪郭のアルファを整え、明暗両方のゲーム背景へ重ねられる均等な照明とする。会話に共用できる明瞭なシルエットとし、周囲は空の透過キャンバスにする。

Standing upright with a slightly reserved posture and facing the viewer at a gentle three-quarter angle. Both empty hands are visible, one loosely held near the chest and the other resting at the side. Detailed painted cloth, leather and hair with gentle natural lighting. Entire head and both feet remain inside the frame, with modest transparent padding.
